body:
# HeatProtect

**An advanced land-protection system where claims aren't boxes you place — they're organic territory that grows from where you actually build.** Dense, lived-in areas lock in automatically; scattered junk never claims land nobody uses. Fully automatic, self-adjusting, and visualized live both in-world, on Dynmap, and on BlueMap

---

## How it works

Traditional claim plugins make you place rigid rectangles. HeatProtect doesn't. Your territory forms from your real building history — the more you build in an area, the stronger your claim, with smooth organic boundaries instead of hard-edged boxes. Build more and your land grows naturally. Leave scattered blocks in the wild and they'll never lock up terrain you're not using.

No commands to memorize a claim grid. No wasted land. Just build, and the world recognizes what's yours.

---

## 🖥️ Server Plugin

The core system. Runs on **Spigot**, derives claims from your existing block history, and enforces protection.

- **Organic, density-based claims** — territory emerges from where players actually build, not manual regions
- **Self-maintaining** — claims recalculate automatically on a schedule; nothing to manage by hand
- **Microsecond protection checks** — every block place and break is validated instantly with zero lag on the server thread
- **Tunable aggressiveness** — configure exactly how much building it takes to claim land
- **Base sharing** — add trusted players to build alongside you in your claim
- **Dynmap integration** — a live server-wide territory layer showing every claim
- **Built on your existing data** — reads block ownership from CoreProtect; no migration, no new tracking

### Player commands
- `/heatprotect show` — outline your claim with particles
- `/heatprotect addmember <player>` — let someone build in your base
- `/heatprotect delmember <player>` — remove a member
- `/heatprotect members` — list your base members
- `/heatprotect info` — show the claim and its strength where you're standing

---

## 🎨 Client Mod

An optional companion mod that renders claims directly in the world.

- **Live in-world heatmap** — see your territory's real shape as you move
- **Per-tile intensity** — view how strong a claim is, not just where it is
- **Clear boundaries** — know exactly where you can and can't build
- **Read-only** — displays server data, never modifies anything

> The client mod is **optional**. The server plugin works fully on its own, and non-modded players still get protection plus the Dynmap layer. The mod simply adds a richer in-world view for those who install it.

---

## Requirements

- **Server:** Spigot, with CoreProtect installed
- **Client mod:** requires a server running the HeatProtect plugin — it does nothing standalone
